capabilities: Set a directory outside any vault as an authoritative config hub
Push hub config to enabled target vaults with SHA-256 incremental sync and dry-run preview
Exclude plugins or file paths from sync via per-plugin toggles and wildcard rules
Back up each vault's .obsidian before overwriting and restore from backup zips
Push and pull hub snapshots to cloud remotes such as GitHub, Google Drive or WebDAV
disambiguation: Not a note-content sync tool like Obsidian Sync; it only distributes .obsidian configuration files and never reads or copies note contents.
extras: Warns that cloud credentials are stored in plaintext in data.json; notes an unrelated community plugin named config-sync; syncs are one-way hub-to-vault only, bidirectional sync and full mobile support are not yet implemented; target vaults opened in another window may need a restart after syncing.
problem: Obsidian stores plugins, themes and settings per vault, so keeping several vaults consistently configured means repeating the same setup and changes by hand.
